bio: This collaboration between Narda Lepes and Inés de los Santos, one of the standout new restaurants of 2023, has been a roaring success. This semicircular wood structure on the corner (hence its name) of Castañeda street is definitely striking and comes with enough discreet Japanese design features to make you feel as though you’re sitting in the Shibuya district of Tokyo. Make sure you start (or finish) with a drink at the bar upstairs, perhaps sipping an “Ash”, its own version of a martini. The open kitchen is fully respectful of the traditions and flavours of Japanese cuisine, so don’t expect any extravagant combinations.
